# Задача: разбор EVTX

В журнале EVTX есть событие Sysmon с флагом. Разбери заголовок файла, чанк и
записи, извлеки строки BinXML и запиши флаг в `found.txt`.

# Parse the EVTX container: header, chunks, records, then extract event strings.
import struct, sys
data = open(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "Security.evtx", "rb").read()
assert data[:8] == b"ElfFile\x00", "not an EVTX file"
chunk_count = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, 0x2A)[0]
print("chunks:", chunk_count)
for c in range(chunk_count):
    base = 4096 + c * 65536
    if data[base:base + 8] != b"ElfChnk\x00":
        continue
    first_id = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, base + 0x18)[0]
    free = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, base + 0x30)[0]
    off = 512
    while off < 65536 - free:
        magic, size = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, base + off)
        if magic != 0x00002A2A or size == 0:
            break
        rec = data[base + off + 24:base + off + size]
        # BinXML keeps template/value strings as UTF-16LE
        try:
            s = rec.decode("utf-16-le", "ignore")
        except Exception:
            s = ""
        clean = "".join(ch for ch in s if 32 <= ord(ch) < 127)
        if clean:
            print("record#%d: %s" % (first_id, clean))
        off += size
